findings.current: but his dull, чуж-like senses couldn’t clearly feel even the wind brushing over him.
findings.defect: The untranslated fragment obscures the comparison: his senses feel as though they belong to someone else.
findings.rationale: 남의 것처럼 means “as though they belonged to someone else”; the current non-English fragment needs replacement.
findings.replacement: but his senses felt so dull and чуж-like that he couldn’t clearly feel even the wind brushing over him.
findings.source: 남의 것처럼 무딘 감각은 전신을 스치는 바람조차 선명히 느끼지 못했다.

findings.current: At the same time, a dark night sky, cold enough to seem almost cold to the touch, spread before him.
findings.defect: The repeated “cold” makes the image incoherent; the sky looks cold because it is so dark.
findings.rationale: 차가워 보일 만큼 어두운 describes the visual impression, not a temperature he can touch.
findings.replacement: At the same time, a night sky so dark it looked cold spread before him.
findings.source: 동시에 차가워 보일 만큼 어두운 밤하늘이 눈앞에 펼쳐졌다.

findings.current: with the keen eyesight natural to a bird of prey
findings.defect: “Bird of prey” adds a species classification absent from the source.
findings.rationale: 날짐승 identifies him as a bird, without specifying a raptor.
findings.replacement: with a bird’s naturally keen eyesight
findings.source: 날짐승의 타고난 안력(眼力)을 지닌 지금의 진태경은

findings.defect: Jeok asks whether Taekyung is coming to, not whether he can hear.
findings.rationale: 정신이 드느냐 concerns regained consciousness; the hesitant opening should remain.

findings.defect: The System notice retains square brackets around a UI term, contrary to the packet’s System-panel rule.
findings.rationale: The framed System blockquote already identifies the notice; its UI term needs no brackets.

findings.defect: The line praises performance instead of acknowledging what Hyuk Mujin endured.
findings.rationale: 고생했어 recognizes hardship, setting up Taekyung’s subdued gratitude that Mujin survived.

findings.current: “I doubt it’ll take more than half a shichen.”
findings.defect: The draft turns an approximate duration into an upper bound.
findings.rationale: 한, 반 시진은 걸리지 않을까 싶다 estimates roughly half a shichen, without promising to return sooner.
findings.replacement: “I think it’ll take about half a shichen.”

summary: The draft preserves the scene, but contains a corrupted phrase, changes Jeok Cheongang’s question, and misrenders several localized details.
